设 $\alpha_{1}$ 是 3 阶矩阵 A 的属于特征值 $\lambda(\lambda \neq 0)$ 的特征向量，3 维列向量 $\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 满足
$$(\lambda E - A) \alpha_ {2} = \alpha_ {1}, (\lambda E - A) \alpha_ {3} = \alpha_ {2}.$$
(I) 证明: $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关;
(II) 计算行列式 $\left|A+A^{*}\right|$ ，其中 $A^{*}$ 是 $A$ 的伴随矩阵.
解析:
证（I）依题设，

$\begin{array}{r l} & {(\lambda E - A) \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} = \mathbf {0} (\pmb {\alpha} _ {1} \neq \mathbf {0}),} \\ & {(\lambda E - A) ^ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} = \mathbf {0}, (\lambda E - A) ^ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} = (\lambda E - A) \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} = \mathbf {0},} \\ & {(\lambda E - A) ^ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} = (\lambda E - A) \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} = \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} \neq \mathbf {0}.} \\ & {k _ {1} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0}.} \end{array}$

设

①

式 ① × (λE - A)²，得 $k_{3}\alpha_{1} = 0$ 。由 $\alpha_{1} \neq 0$ ，得 $k_{3} = 0$ 。将 $k_{3} = 0$ 代入式 ①，得

$k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = \mathbf {0}.②$

式 ②×(λE-A)，得 $k_{2}\alpha_{1}=0$ 。由 $\alpha_{1}\neq0$ ，得 $k_{2}=0$ 。将 $k_{2}=0$ 代入式 ②，得 $k_{1}\alpha_{1}=0$ 。由 $\alpha_{1}\neq0$ ，得 $k_{1}=0$ 。

故 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.

解（Ⅱ）记 $P=(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3})$ ，由（Ⅰ）知P可逆.

由已知及 $(\lambda E - A)\alpha_{2} = \alpha_{1}, (\lambda E - A)\alpha_{3} = \alpha_{2}$ ，可得

则

$\begin{array}{r l} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} & = \lambda \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \quad \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = \lambda \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \quad \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = \lambda \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \\ \mathbf {A} (\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}) & = (\lambda \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \lambda \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \lambda \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}) \\ & = (\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda & - 1 & 0 \\ 0 & \lambda & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & \lambda \end{array} \right). \end{array}$

故 $P^{-1}AP=\begin{pmatrix}\lambda&-1&0\\0&\lambda&-1\\0&0&\lambda\end{pmatrix}$ ，且 $|A|=\lambda^{3}$ .

又

$\boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {P} = \boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} (\left| \boldsymbol {A} \right| \boldsymbol {A} ^ {- 1}) \boldsymbol {P} = \lambda^ {3} \boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {P} = \lambda^ {3} (\boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {P}) ^ {- 1}$

$= \lambda^ {3} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda & - 1 & 0 \\ 0 & \lambda & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & \lambda \end{array} \right) ^ {- 1} = \lambda^ {3} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \frac {1}{\lambda} & \frac {1}{\lambda^ {2}} & \frac {1}{\lambda^ {3}} \\ 0 & \frac {1}{\lambda} & \frac {1}{\lambda^ {2}} \\ 0 & 0 & \frac {1}{\lambda} \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda^ {2} & \lambda & 1 \\ 0 & \lambda^ {2} & \lambda \\ 0 & 0 & \lambda^ {2} \end{array} \right),$

$\begin{array}{r l} \mathbf {P} ^ {- 1} (\mathbf {A} + \mathbf {A} ^ {*}) \mathbf {P} & = \mathbf {P} ^ {- 1} \mathbf {A} \mathbf {P} + \mathbf {P} ^ {- 1} \mathbf {A} ^ {*} \mathbf {P} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda & - 1 & 0 \\ 0 & \lambda & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & \lambda \end{array} \right) + \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda^ {2} & \lambda & 1 \\ 0 & \lambda^ {2} & \lambda \\ 0 & 0 & \lambda^ {2} \end{array} \right) \\ & = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda + \lambda^ {2} & \lambda - 1 & 1 \\ 0 & \lambda + \lambda^ {2} & \lambda - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & \lambda + \lambda^ {2} \end{array} \right), \end{array}$

故 $\left|A+A^{*}\right|=(\lambda+\lambda^{2})^{3}$ .

证（I）用定义证. 设

$k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\beta} + k _ {2} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\beta} + k _ {3} \mathbf {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\beta} = \mathbf {0},①$

由已知有

$\begin{array}{r l} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta} & = \boldsymbol {A} (\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}) = \lambda_ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + \lambda_ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \lambda_ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}, \\ \boldsymbol {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\beta} & = \lambda_ {1} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + \lambda_ {2} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \lambda_ {3} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}. \end{array}$

将 $\beta = \alpha_{1} + \alpha_{2} + \alpha_{3}$ 及以上两式代入式①, 整理得

$\left(k _ {1} + k _ {2} \lambda_ {1} + k _ {3} \lambda_ {1} ^ {2}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + \left(k _ {1} + k _ {2} \lambda_ {2} + k _ {3} \lambda_ {2} ^ {2}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \left(k _ {1} + k _ {2} \lambda_ {3} + k _ {3} \lambda_ {3} ^ {2}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0},$

由于 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 是不同特征值对应的特征向量，故它们线性无关，所以

$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} k _ {1} + k _ {2} \lambda_ {1} + k _ {3} \lambda_ {1} ^ {2} = 0, \\ k _ {1} + k _ {2} \lambda_ {2} + k _ {3} \lambda_ {2} ^ {2} = 0, \\ k _ {1} + k _ {2} \lambda_ {3} + k _ {3} \lambda_ {3} ^ {2} = 0, \end{array} \right.$

其系数行列式 $\begin{vmatrix}1&\lambda_{1}&\lambda_{1}^{2}\\1&\lambda_{2}&\lambda_{2}^{2}\\1&\lambda_{3}&\lambda_{3}^{2}\end{vmatrix}\neq0$ ,所以 $k_{1}=k_{2}=k_{3}=0$ ,故 $\beta,A\beta,A^{2}\beta$ 线性无关.

解（Ⅱ）由 $A^{3}\beta = A\beta$ ，有

$\boldsymbol {A} (\boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\beta}) = (\boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} ^ {3} \boldsymbol {\beta}) = (\boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta}) = (\boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\beta}) \left( \begin{array}{l l l} 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right).$

令 $\boldsymbol{P} = (\boldsymbol{\beta}, \boldsymbol{A}\boldsymbol{\beta}, \boldsymbol{A}^{2}\boldsymbol{\beta})$ ，故 AP = PB，其中 $B = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ ，即 $P^{-1}AP = B$ ，所以 A - E 与 B - E 相似，故 $r(A - E) = r(B - E)$ 。而

$\mathrm{r} (\boldsymbol {B} - \boldsymbol {E}) = \mathrm{r} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} {- 1} & {0} & {0} \\ {1} & {- 1} & {1} \\ {0} & {1} & {- 1} \end{array} \right)= 2,$

所以 $\mathrm{r}(\mathbf{A}-\mathbf{E})=2.$

$(I) \mathbf {A} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \left( \begin{array}{c} a _ {1} \\ a _ {2} \\ \vdots \\ a _ {n} \end{array} \right) (b _ {1}, b _ {2}, \dots , b _ {n}) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} a _ {1} b _ {1} & a _ {1} b _ {2} & \dots & a _ {1} b _ {n} \\ a _ {2} b _ {1} & a _ {2} b _ {2} & \dots & a _ {2} b _ {n} \\ \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ a _ {n} b _ {1} & a _ {n} b _ {2} & \dots & a _ {n} b _ {n} \end{array} \right).$

用定义, 设 A 的任一个特征值为 $\lambda$ , 对应的特征向量为 $\xi$ , 则

$\boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\xi} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\xi} = \lambda \boldsymbol {\xi}.①$

式 ① 两边左乘 $\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}$ , 得 $\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha}\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\xi} = \lambda \boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\xi}$ . 当 $\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\xi} \neq \mathbf{0}$ 时, 有 $\lambda = \boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i}b_{i}$ ; 当 $\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\xi} = \mathbf{0}$ 时, 由式 ① 知 $\lambda = 0$ , 故 $\mathbf{A}$ 的特征值为 $\lambda = 0$ 或 $\lambda = \boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i}b_{i}$ .

（Ⅱ）当 $\alpha^{T}\beta=\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{i}b_{i}=0$ 时，由（Ⅰ）知，A 的全部特征值为 $\lambda=0(n$ 重根 $)$ . 因为 $\alpha\neq0,\beta\neq0$ ，故 $A=\alpha\beta^{T}\neq O$ . 于是 $r(A)=1$ . 但对应 $\lambda=0(n$ 重根 $)$ 的线性无关的特征向量满足 $(0E-A)x=0$ ，即 $Ax=0$，因此只有 $n-r(A)=n-1$ 个基础解系，即只有 $n-1$ 个线性无关的特征向量，故 A 不能相似于对角矩阵.

当 $\alpha^{T}\beta = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} b_{i} \neq 0$ 时，对于 $\lambda = \alpha^{T}\beta$ ，由 $(\lambda E - A)\xi = (\alpha^{T}\beta E - \alpha\beta^{T})\xi = 0$ ，以及

$\left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {T} \boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {T}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {T} \boldsymbol {\beta}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} \left(\boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {T} \boldsymbol {\alpha}\right) = \mathbf {0},$

知对应的特征向量 $\xi_{1}=\alpha$ ，对于 $\lambda=0$ ，由于 $(0E-A)\xi=0$ ，即 $A\xi=\alpha\beta^{T}\xi=0$ ，故有

$\boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {T} \boldsymbol {\xi} = b _ {1} x _ {1} + b _ {2} x _ {2} + \dots + b _ {n} x _ {n} = 0.②$

因 $\beta \neq 0$ ，不妨设 $b_{1} \neq 0$ ，解方程②得线性无关的特征向量为

$\begin{array}{r l} & {\pmb {\xi} _ {2} = (b _ {2}, - b _ {1}, 0, \dots , 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}},} \\ & {\pmb {\xi} _ {3} = (b _ {3}, 0, - b _ {1}, 0, \dots , 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}},} \\ & {\qquad \vdots} \\ & {\pmb {\xi} _ {n} = (b _ {n}, 0, \dots , 0, - b _ {1}) ^ {\mathrm{T}}.} \end{array}$

$\text {令} \pmb {P} = (\pmb {\xi} _ {1}, \pmb {\xi} _ {2}, \dots , \pmb {\xi} _ {n}) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} {{a _ {1}}} & {{b _ {2}}} & {{b _ {3}}} & {{\dots}} & {{b _ {n}}} \\ {{a _ {2}}} & {{- b _ {1}}} & {{0}} & {{\dots}} & {{0}} \\ {{a _ {3}}} & {{0}} & {{- b _ {1}}} & {{\dots}} & {{0}} \\ {{\vdots}} & {{\vdots}} & {{\vdots}} & {} & {{\vdots}} \\ {{a _ {n}}} & {{0}} & {{0}} & {{\dots}} & {{- b _ {1}}} \end{array} \right), \text {使} \pmb {P} ^ {- 1} \pmb {A} \pmb {P} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} {{\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} b _ {i}}} & {} & {} & {} & {} \\ {} & {{0}} & {} & {} & {} \\ {} & {} & {{\ddots}} & {} & {} \\ {} & {} & {} & {} & {{0}} \end{array} \right).$

【注】① 此题 $A = \alpha \beta^{T}$ ，显然 $r(A) = 1$ ，故 $A^{2} = kA$ ，其中 $k = \beta^{T} \alpha = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i} b_{i}$ ，即

$\mathbf {A} ^ {2} = (\boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha}) \mathbf {A}.$

设 A 的任意一个特征值为 $\lambda$ ，则 $A^{2} - (\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha})A$ 有特征值 $\lambda^{2} - (\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha})\lambda$ .

而 $\boldsymbol{A}^{2}-(\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha})\boldsymbol{A}=\boldsymbol{O}$ ，故 $\lambda^{2}-(\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha})\lambda=0$ ，从而 A 有特征值 $\lambda=0,\lambda=\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{i}b_{i}$ （这实际上是秩为 1 的矩阵特征值的结论）.

② 求 A 的特征值、特征向量的常用方法：

(i) 当 A 是具体矩阵时, 用公式 $\left|\lambda E-A\right|=0, (\lambda E-A)x=0;$

(ii) 当 A 是抽象矩阵时, 用定义 $A\alpha = \lambda\alpha (\alpha \neq 0)$ .

$\text {解} (I) A = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} a - 1 & & & \\ & a - 1 & & \\ & & \ddots & \\ & & & a - 1 \end{array} \right) + \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \\ \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 1 & 1 & \dots & 1 \end{array} \right) \stackrel {\text {记}} {=} (a - 1) E + B.$

由 $r(\boldsymbol{B})=1,\left|\lambda\boldsymbol{E}-\boldsymbol{B}\right|=0$ , 得 B 的特征值为 $\lambda_{1}=\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{ii}=n,\lambda_{2}=\lambda_{3}=\cdots=\lambda_{n}=0$ , 于是 A 的特征值为 $n+(a-1),0+(a-1),\cdots,0+(a-1)$ .

下面求 B 的特征向量.

由 $(nE-B)x=0$ ，得 $\alpha_{1}=(1,1,\cdots,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ；由 $(0E-B)x=0$ ，得

$\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = (1, - 1, 0, \dots , 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = (1, 0, - 1, \dots , 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \dots , \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {n} = (1, 0, 0, \dots , - 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}},$

由特征值、特征向量的性质,知 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 也是 A 的特征向量.

令 $\boldsymbol{P}=(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{n})$ ，则 $P^{-1}AP=\operatorname{diag}[n+(a-1),a-1,\cdots,a-1]$ .

（Ⅱ）由（Ⅰ）知 $A \sim \Lambda$ ，故 $|A| = |\Lambda| = (n + a - 1)(a - 1)^{n-1}$ ，所以

$\mathrm{r} (\mathbf {A}) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} n, & a \neq 1 - n \text {且} a \neq 1, \\ n - 1, & a = 1 - n, \\ 1, & a = 1, \end{array} \right.$

故

$\mathrm{r} (\pmb {A} ^ {*}) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} n, & a \neq 1 - n \text {且} a \neq 1, \\ 1, & a = 1 - n, \\ 0, & a = 1. \end{array} \right.$

【注】① 设 $B\alpha = \lambda\alpha (\alpha \neq 0)$ , $A = (a - 1)E + B$ , 则

$\boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = [ (a - 1) \boldsymbol {E} + \boldsymbol {B} ] \boldsymbol {\alpha} = (a - 1) \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \boldsymbol {B} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = (a - 1) \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \lambda \boldsymbol {\alpha} = (a - 1 + \lambda) \boldsymbol {\alpha},$

故 $\alpha$ 是 A 对应特征值 $a-1+\lambda$ 的特征向量.

事实上,一般地,设 $A\alpha = \lambda\alpha (\alpha \neq 0)$ , $f(x)$ 为多项式,则 $\alpha$ 为 $f(A)$ 的特征向量.

② 此题直接求矩阵 A 的特征值和特征向量较烦琐, 将 A 写成 $\boldsymbol{A} = (a - 1)\boldsymbol{E} + \boldsymbol{B}$ , 利用 $\mathrm{r}(\boldsymbol{B}) = 1$ 求 B 的特征值和特征向量较方便. 秩为 1 的矩阵的特征值和特征向量有结论, 见《2027 考研数学线性代数辅导讲义》.

证（I）由 $\alpha^{T}\beta=0$ ，知 $\boldsymbol{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\alpha}=(\boldsymbol{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{\beta})^{\mathrm{T}}=0$ ，即 $\alpha,\beta$ 为单位正交列向量。由已知，

$\boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \boldsymbol {\beta}, \quad \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} + \boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} = \boldsymbol {\alpha}$

$\mathbf {A} (\boldsymbol {\alpha} + \boldsymbol {\beta}) = \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \boldsymbol {\beta}, \mathbf {A} (\boldsymbol {\alpha} - \boldsymbol {\beta}) = - (\boldsymbol {\alpha} - \boldsymbol {\beta}).$

由已知, $\alpha,\beta$ 为单位正交列向量,所以 $\alpha,\beta$ 线性无关,故

$\alpha + \beta \neq 0, \quad \alpha - \beta \neq 0.$

所以 1, -1 是 A 的特征值, 又

$\mathrm{r} (\boldsymbol {A}) = \mathrm{r} \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} + \boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) \leqslant \mathrm{r} \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) + \mathrm{r} \left(\boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) = 1 + 1 = 2,$

故 A 不可逆, 所以 0 是 A 的特征值, 即 A 有 3 个不同的特征值 1, -1, 0, 从而

$\boldsymbol {A} \sim \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & & \\ & - 1 & \\ & & 0 \end{array} \right).$

解（Ⅱ）由 $A\gamma = 0, \gamma \neq 0$ ，知 $\gamma$ 是特征值 0 对应的特征向量，所以 0,1,-1 分别对应的特征向量为 $\gamma, 2(\alpha + \beta), \beta - \alpha$ ，故 $P^{-1}AP = \begin{pmatrix} 0 & & \\ & 1 & \\ & & -1 \end{pmatrix}$ .

【注】① 若 $\alpha + \beta$ 是 A 的特征向量，则 $k(\alpha + \beta)(k \neq 0)$ 也是 A 的特征向量.

② 由 $A = \alpha\beta^{T} + \beta\alpha^{T}$ ，可得

$\boldsymbol {A} ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} + \boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) ^ {\mathrm{T}} + \left(\boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {\mathrm{T}}\right) ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \boldsymbol {\beta} \boldsymbol {\alpha} ^ {\mathrm{T}} + \boldsymbol {\alpha} \boldsymbol {\beta} ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \boldsymbol {A},$

故 A 是实对称矩阵, 所以 $A \sim \Lambda$ .

解（I）由 $BA = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2a_{12} & 2a_{13} \\ 1 & 2a_{22} & 2a_{23} \\ 1 & 2a_{32} & 2a_{33} \end{pmatrix}$ ，得

$\boldsymbol {B} \left( \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {B} \left( \begin{array}{l} a _ {1 2} \\ a _ {2 2} \\ a _ {3 2} \end{array} \right) = 2 \left( \begin{array}{l} a _ {1 2} \\ a _ {2 2} \\ a _ {3 2} \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {B} \left( \begin{array}{l} a _ {1 3} \\ a _ {2 3} \\ a _ {3 3} \end{array} \right) = 2 \left( \begin{array}{l} a _ {1 3} \\ a _ {2 3} \\ a _ {3 3} \end{array} \right),$

所以 B 的特征值为 $\lambda_{1}=1,\lambda_{2}=\lambda_{3}=2,\lambda_{1}=1$ 对应的特征向量为 $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}=(1,1,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ .

令 $\lambda_{2} = \lambda_{3} = 2$ 对应的特征向量为 $x = (x_{1}, x_{2}, x_{3})^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，则由于 $B$ 为实对称矩阵，故 $x^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha_{1} = 0$ ，即 $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3} = 0$ ，解得

$\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = (- 1, 0, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = (- 1, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}.$

故 B 的对应 $\lambda_{2} = \lambda_{3} = 2$ 的特征向量为 $k_{2}\alpha_{2} + k_{3}\alpha_{3}$ ，其中 $k_{2}, k_{3}$ 为不全为 0 的任意常数.

(Ⅱ) 对 $\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 正交化, 令

$\boldsymbol {\beta} _ {2} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {3} = \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right) - \frac {1}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right) = \frac {1}{2} \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1 \\ 2 \\ - 1 \end{array} \right),$

再单位化,得

$\boldsymbol {\gamma} _ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} \left( \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {\gamma} _ {2} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {\gamma} _ {3} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} \left( \begin{array}{c} - 1 \\ 2 \\ - 1 \end{array} \right).$

令 $Q = (\gamma_{1}, \gamma_{2}, \gamma_{3})$ ，则 Q 为正交矩阵，使得 $Q^{-1} BQ = Q^{T} BQ = A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & & \\ & 2 & \\ & & 2 \end{pmatrix}$ .

设 $A$ 是 3 阶实对称矩阵，存在可逆矩阵 $P$ ，使得 $P^{-1}$ ，使得 $P^{-1} = \text{diag}(1,2,-1)$ ，且

②

$\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = (k - 1) x _ {1} - k x _ {2} + x _ {3} = 0,③$

由式 ① 解得 k = 1 或 k = -1.

当 $k = 1$ 时，由式②、式③解得 $\pmb{\alpha}_{3} = (-4,1,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，且

$\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} = (1, 2, 2) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = (0, - 1, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\beta} = (2, - 5, 3) ^ {\mathrm{T}}.$

又由已知

$\boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} \boldsymbol {\beta} = \lambda_ {0} \boldsymbol {\beta},④$

式 ④ 左乘 A，得 $AA^{*}\beta = \lambda_{0}A\beta, |A| \beta = \lambda_{0}A\beta$ ，即

$\boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\beta} = \frac {| \boldsymbol {A} |}{\lambda_ {0}} \boldsymbol {\beta} = - \frac {2}{\lambda_ {0}} \boldsymbol {\beta} \quad (| \boldsymbol {A} | = \lambda_ {1} \lambda_ {2} \lambda_ {3} = - 2),$

故 $\beta$ 应是 A 的特征向量，但 $\beta$ 与 A 的特征向量 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 中的任意一个都不共线，即 $\beta$ 不是 A 的特征向量，所以 k = 1 不合题意，舍去.

当 $k = -1$ 时， $\pmb{\alpha}_{1} = (1,0,2)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，且

故

$\begin{array}{r l} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} & = (- 2, 1, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = (- 2, - 5, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\beta} = (2, 5, - 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \\ & \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = \lambda_ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}, \end{array}⑤$

$$- 2 (- \boldsymbol {\beta}) = - \boldsymbol {A} ^ {*} (- \boldsymbol {\beta}),$$

(Ⅱ) 由于

题目内容: 设数列 $\{a_{n}\},\{b_{n}\}$ 满足 $\begin{pmatrix}a_{n}\\ b_{n}\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\ -1&4\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}a_{n-1}\\ b_{n-1}\end{pmatrix}(n=1,2,\cdots),a_{0}=1,b_{0}=-1$ ，求级数 $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{1}{a_{n}-b_{n}}$ .
解析:
解 依题设所给的递推关系,有

$\binom {a _ {n}} {b _ {n}} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 2 \\ - 1 & 4 \end{array} \right) \binom {a _ {n - 1}} {b _ {n - 1}} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 2 \\ - 1 & 4 \end{array} \right) ^ {2} \binom {a _ {n - 2}} {b _ {n - 2}} = \dots = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 2 \\ - 1 & 4 \end{array} \right) ^ {n} \binom {a _ {0}} {b _ {0}}.$

记 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ -1 & 4 \end{pmatrix}$ ，为求出 $a_{n}, b_{n}$ ，只要求 $A^{n}$ ，为此先求出 A 的特征值和特征向量.

由

$| \lambda E - A | = \left| \begin{array}{c c} \lambda - 1 & - 2 \\ 1 & \lambda - 4 \end{array} \right| = (\lambda - 2) (\lambda - 3) = 0,$

得 A 的特征值为 $\lambda_{1}=2,\lambda_{2}=3.$

由 $(2E-A)X=0$ ，得A的特征向量为 $\alpha_{1}=(2,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ;

由 $(3E-A)X=0$ ，得A的特征向量为 $\alpha_{2}=(1,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ .

令 $\boldsymbol{P} = (\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}, \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2})$ ，则 $P^{-1} A P = \Lambda = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ ，故 $A = P \Lambda P^{-1}$

$\boldsymbol {A} ^ {n} = \boldsymbol {P} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} ^ {n} \boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} = \left( \begin{array}{l l} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 2 ^ {n} & 0 \\ 0 & 3 ^ {n} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & - 1 \\ - 1 & 2 \end{array} \right),$

所以

$\binom {a _ {n}} {b _ {n}} = \boldsymbol {A} ^ {n} \binom {a _ {0}} {b _ {0}} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 2 ^ {n} & 0 \\ 0 & 3 ^ {n} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & - 1 \\ - 1 & 2 \end{array} \right) \binom {1} {- 1} = \binom {2 ^ {n + 2} - 3 ^ {n + 1}} {2 ^ {n + 1} - 3 ^ {n + 1}}.$

于是

$a _ {n} - b _ {n} = 2 ^ {n + 2} - 3 ^ {n + 1} - (2 ^ {n + 1} - 3 ^ {n + 1}) = 2 ^ {n + 1},$

故

$\sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{a _ {n} - b _ {n}} = \sum_ {n = 0} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{2 ^ {n + 1}} = \frac {\frac {1}{2}}{1 - \frac {1}{2}} = 1.$
